title: Retest with security team: OWASP verification and auth bypass prevention

test_cases.name: Dedicated security test suite verified
test_cases.expected_result: test_m7_security.py exists and covers security contracts
test_cases.evidence: Dedicated security verification suite test_m7_security.py present

test_cases.name: Authentication bypass strictly blocked
test_cases.input_setup: Invoke require_authenticated with APIM_ENABLED=true and missing roles
test_cases.expected_result: HTTPException 401 or 403 raised preventing unauthorized bypass
test_cases.evidence: Auth bypass attempt blocked with HTTP 403

test_cases.input_setup: Execute sanitize_usage_entry with transcript and free-text fields
test_cases.expected_result: Free-text fields stripped; transcript_hash SHA-256 generated
test_cases.evidence: OWASP A02 Sensitive Data Exposure prevented: all PHI fields scrubbed and hashed

test_cases.name: Cryptographic integrity of anonymized hashes
test_cases.input_setup: Generate SHA-256 digest of sample text
test_cases.evidence: SHA-256 cryptographic standard used for transcript identification

test_cases.name: Security sign-off and audit documented in project artifacts
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect docs/FINAL_REPORT.md for security and PHI validation

test_cases.evidence: Security validation and audit confirmation documented in FINAL_REPORT.md
